heading.purpose: Panel names, dialog titles, empty-state headings.

name.purpose: Project name, inspected clip name, inspector section titles.

tag.purpose: Track tags (V1, A1); the only uppercase.

measure.purpose: Durations, timecode, dimensions, fps, ruler marks.

shadows.name: dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: The New project dialog over a 75% ground scrim; the only lifted surface.

shadows.name: thumb-lift
shadows.purpose: Slider thumb separation from its track.

shadows.name: surface-ring
shadows.purpose: Cut-out ring around station ticks, the interchange, the playhead dot (3px) and status dots.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing: every transition and the dialog entrance.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and opacity state changes.

motion.name: press
motion.value: 120ms ease-out, scale(0.97) buttons, scale(0.94) icon buttons, scale(1.12) slider thumb

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables dialog-in, scrim-in, shimmer and button transitions.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default action: raised enamel, line border, 28px.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 4v11M7 10l5 5 5-5M5 20h14"/></svg>Import media…</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:28px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); background:var(--color-raised,#1a1f29); border:1px solid var(--color-line,#303640); color:var(--color-ink,#eaedf2); font:500 12.5px/16px 'Fira Sans', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:var(--color-hover,#222833); } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-go-text,#72d699); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Go Button
components.description: The one primary action per view: your line.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-go"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>New project</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-go { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:36px; padding:0 16px; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); background:var(--color-go,#4bc680); border:1px solid transparent; color:var(--color-go-ink,#0a1a10); font:600 12.5px/16px 'Fira Sans', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-go:hover { background:var(--color-go-hi,#5fd290); } .ds-btn-go:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-go:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-go-text,#72d699); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:28px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; color:var(--color-ink-2,#b8bec8); font:500 12.5px/16px 'Fira Sans', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--color-hover,#222833); color:var(--color-ink,#eaedf2); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-go-text,#72d699); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Recessed ground well; border turns green on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { height:28px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); background:var(--color-ground,#0b0e15); border:1px solid var(--color-line,#303640); color:var(--color-ink,#eaedf2); font:400 12.5px/16px 'Fira Sans', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', system-ui, sans-serif; outline:none; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--color-ink-3,#959ca7); } .ds-field:focus { border-color:var(--color-go,#4bc680); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Neutral choice in a ground well; the chosen option takes the hover fill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:flex; gap:2px; padding:2px; border-radius:7px; background:var(--color-ground,#0b0e15); border:1px solid var(--color-line-soft,#232832); width:300px; } .ds-seg button { flex:1; height:24px; padding:0 8px; border:0; border-radius:5px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink-2,#b8bec8); font:500 12px/16px 'Fira Sans', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-seg button:hover { color:var(--color-ink,#eaedf2); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--color-hover,#222833); color:var(--color-ink,#eaedf2); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-go-text,#72d699); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Line Roundels
components.description: Media type colour plus letter; the same mark in tiles, tracks, inspector and cards.
components.css: .ds-roundels { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .ds-roundel { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:9px; color:var(--color-ground,#0b0e15); font:600 10px/1 'Fira Sans', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tag { color:var(--color-ink-2,#b8bec8); font:600 10.5px/14px 'Fira Sans', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Route Timeline Track
components.description: A rail in the line colour, a clip block on it, a station tick and the green playhead with its readout.
components.css: .ds-route { position:relative; width:420px; height:86px; background:var(--color-surface,#12161e); border:1px solid var(--color-line-soft,#232832); border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-rail { position:absolute; left:0; right:14px; top:55px; height:4px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-video,#639be1); opacity:0.7; } .ds-clip { position:absolute; left:24px; width:180px; top:34px; bottom:6px; border-radius:5px; border:1px solid rgb(234 237 242 / 0.1); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-video,#639be1) 20%, var(--color-surface,#12161e)); box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--color-video,#639be1); } .ds-clip span { display:block; padding:4px 8px 0; color:var(--color-ink,#eaedf2); font:500 11px/14px 'Fira Sans', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tick { position:absolute; left:204px; top:30px; bottom:2px; width:4px; margin-left:-2px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-ink,#eaedf2); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-surface,#12161e); } .ds-head { position:absolute; left:140px; top:0; bottom:0; width:2px; margin-left:-1px; background:var(--color-go,#4bc680); } .ds-dot { position:absolute; left:-6px; top:19px; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-go,#4bc680); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--color-surface,#12161e); } .ds-flag { position:absolute; left:10px; top:4px; padding:0 6px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-go,#4bc680); color:var(--color-go-ink,#0a1a10); font:500 10.5px/16px 'Fira Mono', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', ui-monospace, monospace; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Transport
components.description: Fira Mono readout, neutral icon buttons, the 38px green play circle.
components.html: 00:03:09 / 00:06:00
components.css: .ds-transport { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; } .ds-readout { margin-right:16px; color:var(--color-ink,#eaedf2); font:500 16px/20px 'Fira Mono', 'Noto Sans Bengali UI', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-readout small { color:var(--color-ink-3,#959ca7); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:400; } .ds-icon { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:30px; height:30px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink-2,#b8bec8); transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-icon:hover { background:var(--color-hover,#222833); color:var(--color-ink,#eaedf2); } .ds-icon:active { transform:scale(0.94); } .ds-icon[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--color-go-soft,rgb(75 198 128 / 0.14)); color:var(--color-go-text,#72d699); } .ds-play { display:grid; place-items:center; width:38px; height:38px; margin:0 6px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-go,#4bc680); color:var(--color-go-ink,#0a1a10); transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-play:hover { background:var(--color-go-hi,#5fd290); } .ds-play:active { transform:scale(0.95); } .ds-icon:focus-visible, .ds-play:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-go-text,#72d699); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
The edit is a route through time. Every track is a coloured rail, every clip a block riding on it, every cut a station tick, and a cut that lines up across tracks becomes an interchange ring. Colour in this system is a line, not a mood: it tells you what kind of media something is, and it says the same thing in the media panel, the inspector, the timeline and the dashboard. Green is "your line": the action that moves your work forward, what you have selected, and where you are.

The chrome is midnight-enamel graphite, OKLCH neutrals stepped in lightness at hue 261 to 267 with chroma around 0.016 to 0.022, so the panels read as dark tinted enamel rather than grey plastic. The footage is the brightest thing on screen; the interface frames it with hairline borders, tonal layering and small radii. Density is that of a working tool: 13px body, 28px controls, 10px gutters between panels.

Everything must stay light on an 8GB Mac. There is no blur and no glow, and only one authored entrance (a dialog). Frame stepping and playhead travel are never animated; the picture is the motion.
keyCharacteristics: Media type colour is a line: video blue, audio purple, stills and titles yellow, used identically in roundels, clip bars, rails and project cards.
Green is reserved for your line: the primary action, selection, the playhead, and the state of your own work (saved, on the timeline, progress).
Hue-262 graphite neutrals in four tonal steps (ground, surface, raised, hover), separated by hairlines, not shadows.
Fira Sans for words, Fira Mono for measurements, Noto Sans Bengali behind both.
Every text colour passes WCAG AA on every surface it sits on.

rules.name: The Colour Is a Line Rule
rules.body: A media type has exactly one colour and one letter (V, A, I), and every surface that shows that type uses both, from the media tile roundel to the timeline rail to the dashboard card. Colour never decorates; it identifies.

rules.name: The Your Line Rule
rules.body: Green belongs to the user's own route: the primary action, selection, the playhead, and the state of their work (saved, on the timeline, progress). Sliders, segmented controls and secondary buttons stay neutral; a slider fills with ink-2, not green.

rules.name: The AA Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Every text colour passes 4.5:1 on every surface it can sit on, ink-3 on hover included. A new text colour that fails on hover enamel does not ship.

rules.name: The Instrument Rule
rules.body: Measurements are set in Fira Mono with tabular figures: timecode, durations, dimensions, fps, dB and percent readouts. Counts and dates ("5 items", "edited Nov 11") are words and stay in Fira Sans with tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Uppercase Rule
rules.body: The track tag is the only uppercase text in the app. No eyebrows, no small-caps section labels.

rules.name: The No Blur Rule
rules.body: No backdrop blur, no glows, no gradient washes; the memory budget forbids them and the footage must stay the brightest thing on screen. A scrim is a flat ground tint.

dos: **Do** give every media type its one colour and letter everywhere it appears: video blue, audio purple, stills yellow.
**Do** keep green for the primary action, selection, the playhead and the state of the user's own work.
**Do** set every measurement (timecode, duration, dimensions, fps, dB, percent) in Fira Mono with tabular figures; set counts and dates in Fira Sans with tabular figures.
**Do** build depth from the ground, surface, raised, hover steps and hairline borders.
**Do** check every new text colour against hover enamel (#222833) for at least 4.5:1.
**Do** keep sliders and segmented controls neutral.
donts: **Don't** use blur, backdrop filters, glows or gradient washes; the 8GB memory budget and the footage both forbid them.
**Don't** add always-running animation to the editor, or animate frame stepping and playhead travel.
**Don't** add a second entrance animation; the dialog's is the only one.
**Don't** use uppercase anywhere but the track tag.
**Don't** use colour decoratively; a hue that is not a media line, green, amber or red has no job here.
**Don't** use pure black; the letterbox is #05070b.
